# Kalma
> Panic & anxiety relief app for iOS. Instant offline grounding, guided breathing, and mood journaling.

Kalma is a mental health app built for panic attacks and anxiety — not general meditation. One-tap Panic Shield works offline. Guided box, 4-7-8, and resonant breathing. Science-backed lessons and trigger tracking.

## Product
- Homepage: https://www.kalma.cc
- Blog: https://www.kalma.cc/blog
- Panic attack help: https://www.kalma.cc/panic-attack-help
- Privacy policy: https://www.kalma.cc/privacy
- Waitlist: https://www.kalma.cc/#waitlist
- RSS feed: https://www.kalma.cc/feed.xml

## Key features
- Panic Shield: one-tap offline grounding during panic attacks
- Breathing: box, 4-7-8, resonant — with Apple Health & Watch
- Learn & Journal: evidence-based micro-lessons, mood & trigger tracking
- Privacy-first, built in the EU (GDPR-aligned)

## Launch
- Platform: iOS (App Store)
- Status: Waitlist open — launching Q1 2026
- Pricing: Free tier with core panic support
